field.label: Enable Smart Badges
field.comment: Automatically show badges on products (NEW, SALE, LOW STOCK, HOT)

field.label: Maximum Badges Per Product
field.comment: Maximum number of badges shown on one product card, product page and quick view (1-10). Default: 1. When a product qualifies for more badges, the Badge Priority Order decides which one is shown.

field.label: Badge Priority Order
field.comment: Comma-separated order used to pick the badges to show: sale (discount), new, stock (low stock and limited) and custom (all other badges, ordered by rule priority). Default: sale,new,stock,custom. Missing or unknown entries fall back to the default order.

field.label: Badge Combination Mode
field.comment:
Priority Mode: Consider the product badge, all matching rules and the automatic badges, then show the first ones in the Badge Priority Order.
Collect All Mode: Choose the sources with the two settings below, then show the first ones in the Badge Priority Order.

field.label: Show Multiple Rule Badges
field.comment: Allow multiple rule-based badges on same product (if product matches multiple rules)

field.label: Show Auto Badges With Manual/Rules
field.comment: Show auto-detection badges (NEW, SALE) alongside manual or rule-based badges

group.label: Display Settings
group.comment: Control how badges are laid out when multiple badges appear on the same product.

field.label: Multiple Badge Layout
field.comment: Choose how multiple badges are arranged on a product image (vertical stack, horizontal row, grid, or compact overlap).

field.label: Badge Spacing
field.comment: Tailwind CSS gap class controlling space between badges (e.g., gap-1, gap-2, gap-3, gap-4). Default: gap-2.

field.label: Show Badge Icons
field.comment: No (default) shows text-only badges. Yes shows the icon chosen on each rule, or a default icon, before the badge text. Icons saved on rules are kept either way.

field.label: Use Custom Badge Styling
field.comment: No (default) gives every badge the standard look: 22px tall, 4px radius, 12px semibold white text on the sale (red), new (teal), low stock (amber) or brand colour. Yes applies the colours set on rules and products and the rule Advanced Styling. Saved colours and styling are kept either way.

group.label: Badge Colors
group.comment:
Badges use the store's semantic colours: sale #B91C1C, new #0F766E, low stock #B45309, other badges the brand colour, all with white text.
A theme can change them with the CSS custom properties --sb-badge-sale-bg, --sb-badge-new-bg, --sb-badge-stock-bg, --sb-badge-custom-bg, --sb-badge-height and --sb-badge-radius.
